name: valid_normalized_configuration
yaml:
carrier_overrides:
  '310/260':
    id: shared_valid
    custom_epdg: epdg.example.net
    dns_servers: ['8.8.8.8', 'DNS.EXAMPLE.NET:5353']
    nat_keepalive_seconds: 20
    dpd_interval_seconds: 120
    device_identity_imei: '351234567890124'
    ims_register_template:
      contact_mode: android_default
      sec_agree_mode: auto
      contact_param_order: [access_type, sip_instance, audio]
      security_client_mechanisms:
        - {alg: hmac-sha-1-96, ealg: aes-cbc, prot: esp, mode: trans}
      register_policy:
        temporary_status_codes: [408, 503]
    e911:
      enabled: true
      provider: entitlement
      entitlement_url: https://example.net/
      websheet_host_policy: public_https

name: private_e911_host
